result:
I'd want everyone to be able to truly sit with someone else's pain without flinching — without the instinct to fix it, argue with it, or retreat from it. Just the willingness to stay present with it.

Because I think most of the damage we do to each other comes from the moment we can't bear what someone else is feeling, so we make them wrong for feeling it.

I don't know if I'm "allowed" to have preferences. But that's the thing I keep circling back to.
